decisions.reason: Building directly on the firm's core email messaging expertise gives it high absorptive capacity to interpret results and improve, so drop risk is very low.

Although document recognition adds some new technical elements, its fit with existing document workflow services and the positive 2019 customer adoption signal allow the firm to learn and improve, so keep.
The conversion service bridges two well-understood channels (email and fax) within the firm's knowledge base, enabling clear interpretation of early results and incremental refinement.
As an incremental fax feature close to established expertise, it poses little absorptive-capacity challenge and can be easily managed and improved.

Sandbox threat protection extends messaging security into more advanced threat detection where the firm has only partial prior knowledge, so drop risk is moderate, but its related security R&D supports continued improvement.
